findings.title: DiskCache freshPayloadWithAge, hasFreshPayload and anyPayloadWithAge repeat the same stat/mtime/age block
findings.evidence: Three copies of the age computation (raised by Higia, remediation B15)
findings.fix: Extract a private payloadAge() and apply TTL/maxStale to it once
findings.impact: TTL rules can drift between the probe and the read
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B15

findings.title: 429 cooldown is stamped from dispatch time, not response arrival, so a slow 429 gets a shorter cooldown
findings.evidence: observeRateLimit(at: now) uses the dispatch clock since CQ-MAE-014 (raised by Higia and Nemesis, remediation B15)
findings.fix: Read the injected clock again when the response arrives
findings.impact: Cooldown shorter than rateLimitCooldown(forAttempt:) by the request duration
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B15

findings.title: OpencodeScanner .unavailable groups caller configuration errors with SQLite read failures
findings.evidence: Alias-set misconfiguration and read errors share one case (raised by Higia, remediation B15)
findings.fix: Separate case or assertion for caller misuse
findings.impact: A misconfigured alias set keeps stale rows
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B15

findings.title: CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md do not document .github/dependabot.yml, its [skip release] prefix, or that the swift ecosystem watches TOMLKit
findings.evidence: Release rule depends on the dependabot prefix but no doc says so (raised by Jano, remediation B15)
findings.fix: Document in Releasing and in the TOMLKit known-limitation note; add a row to the release-failure table about skip-release action bumps
findings.impact: A maintainer editing the prefix could trigger releases
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B15

findings.title: Bare-Int ratchet blanks the whole radix call, hiding a trapping conversion nested in its arguments such as Int(Int(d), radix: 16)
findings.evidence: Corner case (raised by Nemesis, remediation B15)
findings.fix: Blank only the radix string argument, or re-scan the call arguments
findings.impact: A nested trapping conversion in a WireTypes file would pass the gate
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B15
